Params: According to the latest intel from our intelligence division, what we're looking for is in Constellia.
The bad news is that the tracker is being disrupted. Constellia has too many similar signals in circulation, and the intercepted fragments share too many overlapping traits with them.
The Science Council is already analyzing it, but it will take some time.
That's alright, as long as we can make sure there's no risk of it leaving the city.
WGAA has designated a commandant they trust to act as your liaison for this operation.
I'm sure you're no stranger to that commandant.
You're just as good a fit from where I stand. Saves us the trouble of learning how to work with each other.
I look forward to seeing you two work together.
According to our last report, the mechanoid carrying the target has no idea of its actual worth, and has been looking for an opportunity to offload it.
Constellia's commercial district is hosting a large market fair right now, so the target is likely planning to sell the item there.
Of course, we'll support you as soon as we can. In the meantime, we'll need you to proceed with the investigation until we have something concrete.
Move quickly, but don't tip anyone off.
With the mission details confirmed, Celica ends the call without another word.
Only the two of you remain on the comms channel.
Let's figure out our next move.
We can blend in as customers.
We can pose as a vendor.
Blending in as customers... A solid call.
Posing as a vendor... and waiting for the target to come to us. It's lower profile, and it's a solid move.
That said, setting up a stall takes a lot of time, making it less viable.
The Constellia market is bustling with activity. Stalls line the streets, displaying goods of all kinds.

Vendors' calls, the clang of metal, and confusing post-modern music rise and fall in the commercial district. Also mixed into the air is the smell of food, machine oil, and the distinct mustiness of thrifted goods.
Adelyde stands at the market entrance, surveying the scene before her like an unmarked battlefield expressionlessly.
Not used to visiting places like this?
...Clearing them out is more my speed.
No matter. I'll just think of it as a supply run.
There are still some differences between them...
In that case, I'll follow your lead.
Let's assess the situation first and figure out a plan of action.
Certainly. The real shape of the target object is unknown, since the target mechanoid has it concealed inside a specially sealed box.
According to Babylonia's intel, the target mechanoid is looking to offload the item. So our focus should be on stalls that deal in reclaimed goods.
On top of that, our data shows that Constellia's market is quite the affair. Anything of value can be bought or sold here.
There may also be an intel market here somewhere, which could also give us a lead.
Intel is only good when it's fresh.
If there are intel brokers around, that should be our first stop.
That said, are intel brokers really that easy to come by...?
You pull up Adelyde's feed on the terminal. A mechanoid with dark red coating is calling out loudly to passersby.
News of the world, big and small, all at your doorstep! Fresh off the press this morning! Who wants a copy!?
"But I don't care about the world! I only care about myself!" Well, whatever you're interested in, I've got it! Fresh intel, guaranteed!
Fair prices and no tricks! If the news is old, it's free!
So intel is sold by freshness, just like produce?
There's some truth to that. Intel loses its value over time.
Knowing the value of his goods means he knows the trade, at the very least.
(Then again, that might just be his sales pitch...)
What are you interested in, ma'am? I've got all kinds of papers right here!
Or perhaps... you're here for the card game tournament? Looking to take home the prize?
(Something about that tournament sounds awfully suspicious...)
Has a mechanoid carrying a box come through here looking to sell?
The way you carry yourself, I half expected you to be a card shark!
The vendor holds his hands apart to indicate the size of the box, then mimes putting on a hat.
The mechanoid's wearing a hood, too, yeah?
You've come to the right person. I happen to know something about this mechanoid.
But, well... intel doesn't come cheap like a newspaper does...
Would 500 Black Cards work for you...?
A woman of few words! I like that!
The one you're looking for headed that way not long ago.
The vendor gestures toward somewhere nearby, where a nondescript alley hides in the shadows between two buildings.
Oh, and feel free to enter that card game tournament I just mentioned! Plenty of great prizes for the winners!
The two of you immediately head that way.
Ten minutes later, at the end of the alley.
I've checked. There are no side paths, nowhere to hide, and nothing to climb over.
Our target would've been gone by now.
He never specified exactly how long ago that was.
...I suppose that's not exactly a lie.
The only lead left is the cafe still open in the alley.
Odd place to run a cafe.
Shall we go in and ask?
Our operation needs to stay under wraps from the general public.
The door swings open, and the chime above rings out. A mechanoid largely coated in red is polishing a coffee cup behind the counter before spotting you and setting down the cup to greet you.
Please, have a seat! What can I get for you? Whatever flavor of electrolyte you're interested in, I've got it!
What's your connection to that intel broker from before?
I-intel broker? We're just a small cafe trying to get by...
A poor excuse for a lie.
The way you both speak and dress... People who live together long enough tend to rub off on each other.
The one you're referring to would be my brother.
So you two are working together to lure people here and spend money at your shop?
I'm innocent! I don't know what you're talking about!
How about this... let me brew you something with the beans we just got in. It's a fresh delivery, and they're really something special...
That's not necessary. I'm in a hurry.
Commandant, this lead has gone cold. We're back to square one.
I suppose there's nothing we can do.
The door chime rings again. A familiar mechanoid steps inside.
Bro, money's coming in fast today! Guess what just happened... A lady asked me for directions, and I pointed her this way before I realized it leads to—
Oh whoa! What a coincidence! You actually came to the shop, ma'am!
So, did you find the person you were looking for?
What do you mean? You didn't point us in the wrong direction?
As if I'd ever do something like that! I got paid to do a job, and reputation is everything in this line of work!
You're looking for someone in a cloak, carrying a box about this big, no?
The vendor does the exact same gestures as before, beating his chest with total confidence.
Came straight here! I'd stake my reputation on it!
Someone like that did come by just a little while ago.
That's the person I'm looking for. Did this person do or say anything after coming here?
The cafe owner scratches his head and heads to the back.
I don't follow. What was that mechanoid doing in a cafe?
Maybe our target was thirsty and wanted a drink?
Maybe our target just wanted to unwind?
Maybe the owner is part of the problem.
We can't rule out the owner. Something fishy might be going on in there.
Good news. The Science Council's results are in, and the signal source has been stationary for over an hour.

Not only did they re-lock onto the source, they also analyzed its electromagnetic traits and cross-referenced them against material models in the database to narrow down what the target object might be.
The report just came in—wait, uh...
I have a bad feeling about this...
Uh... The object was initially suspected to be a rare biological material, one that plays a significant role in ongoing research on stabilizing M.I.N.D.
However, after careful analysis, the Science Council has determined that it more closely resembles a plant from the Rubiaceae family in the same region...
Which means it could be... a box of coffee beans...
The one you're looking for came by and sold me something. Here, take a look!
These coffee beans are incredibly rare. The yield is minuscule, and everyone says a cup of this feels like a spa day for your mind!
Oh, now that's a rare find. They even use it as a special prize at the card game tournament.
That's what I'd expect from you, bro. You know quality when you see it.
Ma'am, these are actually the beans I was going to treat you to! And I've already ground some, as luck would have it. So, what do you say?
Huh? Why do you look so pale, ma'am?
Celica, given the change in mission objective, should we reassess the mission level?
But... ugh... regardless, we still need to collect a sample before calling it a day...
Besides, the Science Council did mention that byproducts sharing the same environmental factors could still be useful for research...
Can we just hand in the coffee?
Probably... not... The proteins, cellular structure, and DNA in the beans' embryos are all completely destroyed in the coffee...
So we'll have to obtain a plant sample.
Didn't the broker mention something about a tournament prize?
You're not talking to me, are you? Would you still like some coffee? Ma'am? Hello?
...The card game tournament your brother just mentioned... What was that about?
